issues.jp_before: 日本[にほん]へ{行[い]ったとき|pt-toki}、かばんを買[か]いました。
issues.problem: English 'when I was in Japan, after I had arrived' was clumsy and redundant.
issues.action: English changed to 'I bought a bag in Japan, after I got there.'

issues.jp_before: 夜[よる]、道[みち]を{歩[ある]くとき|pt-toki}、明[あか]るい道[みち]を選[えら]びます。
issues.problem: 道 repeated in one short sentence (道を歩くとき…明るい道を選びます), awkward.
issues.action: Rewritten as 夜、一人で歩くとき、明るい道を選びます; English 'When I walk alone at night, I choose well-lit streets.'

issues.jp_before: 病院[びょういん]で薬[くすり]を{もらうとき|pt-toki}、保険証[ほけんしょう]を見[み]せます。
issues.problem: The insurance card is shown at hospital reception, not when receiving medicine; the scene was unrealistic.
issues.action: Changed 病院 to 薬局 (pharmacy), English updated.

issues.jp_before: 窓[まど]を{開[あ]けたとき|pt-toki}、冷[つめ]たい風[かぜ]が入[はい]ってきました。
issues.problem: Distractor 開けているとき ('while I had the window open') is natural and describes the same situation, so it is not plainly wrong.
issues.action: Replaced distractor with 開けたいとき.

issues.jp_before: 京都[きょうと]へ{行[い]ったとき|pt-toki}、有名[ゆうめい]なお寺[てら]を見[み]ました。
issues.problem: English 'When I went to Kyoto' does not rule out 'on the way to Kyoto' (行くとき).
issues.action: English changed to '...I saw a famous temple there.'

issues.jp_before: 風邪[かぜ]を{ひいたとき|pt-toki}、いつもこの薬[くすり]を飲[の]みます。
issues.problem: English 'When I have caught a cold' was unnatural.
issues.action: English changed to 'When I catch a cold, I always take this medicine.'
